meta.name: safe-mode
meta.description: Prevent destructive operations using Claude Code hooks. Three modes — cautious (warn on dangerous commands), lockdown (restrict edits to one directory), and clear (remove restrictions). Uses PreToolUse matchers for Bash, Edit, and Write.

copy.tagline: 防止误删文件或执行危险命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在开发时担心误删或误执行破坏性命令
copy.tagline_en: Prevent accidental file deletion or dangerous commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry about accidental deletion or destructive commands during development

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在执行危险命令前发出警告，或限制文件编辑范围到指定目录，防止误操作。
howto.when: 当你输入 /safe-mode cautious 或 /safe-mode lockdown <路径> 时触发。

say.note: Claude 会警告危险命令但不阻止。
Claude 只允许修改该目录下的文件。
Claude 会关闭当前会话的所有保护。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude warns before executing dangerous commands or restricts file edits to a specified directory to prevent accidental damage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /safe-mode cautious or /safe-mode lockdown <path>.

say_en.note: Claude will warn on dangerous commands but not block.
Claude will only allow edits inside that directory.
Claude removes all protections for this session.
